verdict.rationale: SerpApi offers ZeroTrace Mode, which stops it from storing search parameters, files, or data once a search completes. That gives users an opt-in no-retention control. Otherwise, results sit in a temporary cache that expires after 1h, and stored searches are retrievable through the Searches Archive API, so default retention is only partly under user control. missing for 10: an explicit deletion API or process for already-stored searches and archive data, configurable retention periods, clarity on which plans include ZeroTrace, and independent corroboration that ZeroTrace works as described.
